audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Zac the chart — content.win and full.phases[].side both read Skill/Zac/Zac/Skill/Skill/Zac/Zac — while every one of the seven whys underneath describes Aurora winning that stage, and Aurora's win rate here is 53.97% over 63 games.
audit.why: Elastic Slingshot is 21/18/15/12/9s and Across the Veil is 22/21/20/19/18s, so at rank 1 his only gap-closer costs almost exactly what her escape costs: bait it and she owns the next twenty seconds. Unstable Matter needs 350 range and The Weirding (825, 15s) exists to deny that. Zac's real edge arrives with items and teamfights, which the existing whys[6] already says.
audit.corrected: Chart set as one atomic group to Aurora / Aurora / Aurora / Aurora / Aurora / Skill / Zac with ratings 7/7/7/7/7/5/3. This is the exact inverse of what the mirror audit in audits/top/zac__aurora.json concluded Zac's chart should be.

audit.whatIsWrong: No stage carried a cooldown, and the level-6 line named 'Between the Worlds', which is not an ability.
audit.why: Aurora's R is Between Worlds, 140/120/100s. Zac's spikes are Elastic Slingshot at level 2-3 (21s at rank 1, falling to 9s at rank 5 — the cooldown halves as the lane goes on) and Let's Bounce! at 120/105/90s. Unstable Matter is a flat 5s at every rank.
audit.corrected: Real names and numbers throughout, including that his engage cooldown drops from 21s to 9s with ranks, which is why Aurora's early window closes.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent. First, Elastic Slingshot's knock-up interrupts Across the Veil mid-cast — the page repeatedly told you to 'W-blink his E', which fails if you react instead of pre-empting. Second, Unstable Matter deals a percentage of max health, so the page's own 'Build MR' advice does not answer it.
audit.why: Riot's kit data flags Elastic Slingshot with knockup and Unstable Matter with percentHealth (350 range, flat 5s). champ-data/_kits/_missing/aurora.json raises both as resistances-invalidated and flags Zac's Stretching Strikes as an auto-reset burst tell.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[1] now says to leap early rather than on reaction; dosFull[1] states that distance, not MR, answers Unstable Matter; wants.foe[0] states the interrupt from his side.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown block carried the words 'matchup-defining', 'Your committal tool' and 'Your ultimate' and not one number.
audit.why: All three relevant cooldowns are in the kit files.
audit.corrected: Elastic Slingshot 21s, Unstable Matter 5s flat, The Weirding 15s/825 written in — the last of which the mirror audit noted was missing from both layers entirely.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal was listed in itemization but the trade lines never connected it to anything, and 'Build MR' was offered as the answer to a percent-max-health spell.
audit.why: Cell Division heals him off reabsorbed blobs and revives him from surviving bloblets; Unstable Matter ignores resistances by design. champ-data/_kits/_missing/aurora.json flags this matchup needs-antiheal.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds tied to Cell Division by name in dontsFull[0] and dontsFull[2]; MR advice replaced with spacing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fabricated name 'Between the Worlds' in phases[4].why and breakdown.late, and the content layer described Between Worlds as walking 'through the wall untargetable' in spikes[1].text, mid, wants.you[2] and whys[4].
audit.why: Riot's Between Worlds text describes damage, a slow, and an area Aurora can teleport across — no wall and no untargetability. The mirror audit reached the same conclusion when it removed the 'double-blink R' description from Zac's page.
audit.corrected: All five strings now describe the zone and the teleport across it, with the 140s cooldown.

notes: MIRROR ACTION REQUIRED: audits/top/zac__aurora.json explicitly declined to propose its level-chart edits, stating 'categorical tokens cannot survive the length band'. That is not true — apply-proposals.js exempts win[N], phases[N].side and phases[N].rating (ENUM_FIELD, apply-proposals.js:78). Zac's page therefore still carries a 7/0 chart and will contradict this one until someone re-proposes it or mirror-fix.js runs. The same file also skipped focus.text on the same false premise. I chose the mirror's recommended split rather than the packet's at row 5 (packet says Aurora at first item, mirror says Skill) so the two directions agree; the content whys[5] has been rewritten to match Skill. Kit-flag caveat: champ-data/_kits/zac.json tags Elastic Slingshot with 'grounding', but Riot's description for it is one sentence about launching himself forward and mentions neither grounding nor a knock-up. I used only the knock-up, which the mirror audit also used and which is consistent with the CC-interrupts-a-leap interaction; I did NOT write grounding anywhere. Whether Across the Veil can be Flash-buffered or cast through the knock-up is not in the data and is left unstated. The 'W-takedown reset' claim appears in four existing strings and is not in Riot's Across the Veil description — I preserved the wording rather than reversing it, but it is unverified.
